THROW-FORWARD: Living on the Dead

By: Laura Byrne | Commission

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
In the Eastern Cape, a longstanding housing crisis has led to a tussle for land between the living and the dead.

Unique Selling Point:
In an upcoming episode of Carte Blanche, we travel to Duncan Village, outside East London, to witness for ourselves a bizarre phenomenon: desperate for somewhere to live, and with government housing contracts failing or stalling, people are taking to the neglected cemeteries, building their houses right on top of the final resting places of the dead.

Script:


UPSOUND: Anonymous: Sometimes I dream I’m at a funeral. I dream I’m in the graveyard.
UPSOUND: Govan: Do you have any family here?
Noni: yes my grandmother is here.
Govan: Is her grave also close to these shacks?
Noni: No, her grave is just there next to the tip somewhere there.
UPSOUND Tembi: we could not really be sure whether it is this corner or that corner.
VOICEOVER: Duncan Village, East London. It’s an area notorious for municipal mismanagement.
UPSOUND: Govan: How long has it been like this?
Man: To be honest, I can't tell you.
Govan: that long huh?
VOICEOVER: And as a decades-long housing crisis deepens…
UPSOUND: Noni: Some they never got their houses until today. They still have their blue cards from 1995. Still today, no luck. They are grown old old people now.
VOICEOVER: …neglected cemeteries become the site of a tussle for land between the living…
UPSOUND: Anonymous: I’ve always had a sense of unease but I'm living here now because I couldn't find another place.
VOICEOVER: …and the dead.
UPSOUND: Noni: There. This is a head of a stone.
Govan: Right.
UPSOUND: Tembi: We couldn't visit because the shacks were timeously coming forward.
VOICEOVER: In an upcoming episode of Carte Blanche…
UPSOUND: Govan: Do you know the true state of the cemeteries, mayor?
Mayor: I know them. I go, I'm a mayor that don’t sit in boardrooms. I go around and I see. Hence I hold my officials accountable.
VOICEOVER: How can we expect to take care of the living…
UPSOUND: Anonymous: You know, I don't have an option. I need to remove them there. They will be built on top of.
VOICEOVER: …when we fail to preserve the dignity of our dead?
UPSOUND: Govan: How are families supposed to get here if it's that hard for me?
